Are you organized, customer-oriented, and ready for a new challenge in international logistics?

As an Air Import Agent, you play a crucial role in coordinating export processes and providing excellent customer service. Read on and discover what your future could look like in our dynamic team!

Jobomschrijving

As an Air Import Agent, you are responsible for smoothly and timely coordinating air freight and providing excellent customer service. You ensure that everything, from freight transportation to administrative processing, runs seamlessly.

As an Air Import Agent, you engage in the following activities:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow.
• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system.
• Track and trace Air Import files as required. This can be either internally via exp.o or externally via airline websites or by telephone to
airline offices.
• Use Tree View on daily basis.
• Ensure timely delivery of freight to customers for Import shipments.
• Ensure documents are timely sent to customer or broker for customs purposes.
• Ensure accurate and timely client and vendors billing.
• Interact with our customers in arranging their international shipments, meeting customer service standards.
• Contribute to maintain strong relationships with vendors (airlines, trucking companies, and others).
• Meet compliance at all times to regulations. 
• Understand department process flow, constantly looking for areas of improved efficiency.
• Ensure all customers standard operating procedures are followed and updated in the DLSOP.
• Overseas communications, timely responses to emails and requests (internal and external)
• Meets company standards of 52 hours training per year per employee.
• Promote compliance in diligently following all company policies and regulations and performing the task at hand with outstanding
integrity and pride.

The Air Import Agent we're looking for:

• 2- 3 years of experience withing air freight (import specifically)
• Proactive attitude and well-developed organizational skills.
• Good knowledge of Excel and Word; experience in air freight/logistics is a plus.
• Very good knowledge of English AND Dutch
• IATA certification is a plus.
• A positive mindset, problem-solving ability, and a good sense of humor.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst
jobs.description:
As a vehicle technician, you are responsible for the maintenance and repair of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles of all makes. You will work in a spacious, modern body shop known for its craftsmanship and customer focus. The workshop specializes in both conventional and electric/hybrid vehicles, so you'll work with the latest automotive technologies.

On a typical day, you’ll independently carry out both minor and major maintenance services. You diagnose technical issues using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and perform mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs. Quality is key, and you ensure every vehicle leaves the workshop in top condition.

Are you a precise, self-reliant technician with a passion for cars? Apply now and become part of a dedicated team. Together, you’ll ensure satisfied customers and vehicles in perfect working order.

• Diploma in automotive technology at secondary education level or equivalent through experience

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a car technician

• Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and systems

• Able to work independently and accurately

• Proficient in English, both spoken and written

• Holder of a valid category B driver’s license

• Passion for vehicles and new technologies

Step into an exciting role as a Folding Machine Operator - this is your chance to work with a team committed to crafting the future of the printing industry, leveraging cutting-edge technology and a no-nonsense approach.Your day will involve setting up and operating folding machines like the Heidelberg Stahlfolder, ensuring that all materials meet quality standards. You’ll perform regular maintenance and minor repairs, keeping your workspace organized and efficient. Collaboration is key, so you’ll hand over tasks smoothly to your colleagues to maintain seamless production.Ready to make your mark in a future-focused company? Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with ample opportunities for growth and development.

• Strong technical insight, preferably with a technical degree

• Ability to work independently and with precision

• Hands-on attitude, ready to assist wherever needed

• Flexibility to switch machines or work overtime when necessary

• At least 5 years of experience as a folding operator in a printing company

• Experience with perfect binding is a plus

• Proficient in English

Dive into a dynamic role where your skills in mechanical assembly will keep everything in its rightful place. As a Pre-Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the meticulous assembly and disassembly of tooling on our state-of-the-art roll forming lines. Your day will involve transporting and maintaining tooling, ensuring a clean and safe workspace, and reporting any repairs or improvements needed. If you thrive in a detail-oriented environment and are eager to learn, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

A typical day sees you inspecting your own work for precision, collaborating with team members, and operating both conventional and CNC-controlled machines. You’ll ensure that every piece meets our high standards of quality and accuracy. This role requires independent work, flexibility, and a keen eye for detail, making sure every component fits perfectly.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

• Education in mechanics or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Eagerness to learn, conscientiousness, and sense of responsibility

• Ability to work independently and safely

• Flexibility and willingness to work in a 2-shift system

• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, order, and cleanliness

• Technical background or equivalent experience

As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be crucial in keeping our advanced machinery running smoothly in the fruit and vegetable food industry. Your role involves handling maintenance tasks and optimizing equipment like flowpackers and labeling machines, ensuring peak efficiency in our production line.

On a typical day, you'll troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform minor repairs, and maintain building systems such as fire alarms. You'll coordinate with suppliers for any complex repairs, ensuring everything runs seamlessly.

• Experience as an all-round maintenance and repair technician
• Experience in the food industry is a plus
• Proficiency in both mechanics and electronics
• Good command of English
• Familiarity with various PC programs

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Rotating Shifts – Become an essential link at SKF!
jobs.description:
Ready to put your career in motion?

SKF is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly. We are looking for motivated warehouse employees who deliver top-quality service to our customers.

Your role as an order picker:
You are a crucial link in our logistics process. Thanks to your speed, precision and eye for detail, you ensure that orders are processed correctly and on time. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and aren’t afraid of a challenge? Then this is the job for you!

Work schedule:

Rotating Shifts: One week 06h until 14h. The next 14h until 22h.

Full-time or part-time. 

For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? You pass our tests on speed, accuracy, numeracy, language skills, spatial insight and attention to detail

As a Truck Driver CE, you are responsible for transporting goods within Belgium, Northern France, and Southern Netherlands. You load and unload the truck yourself with an electric pallet truck and always check your documents and vehicle. You register everything correctly in the onboard computer. Ready to hit the road independently? Apply now!

• You have a CE driving license and a valid professional competence certificate (code 95).

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Truck Driver CE.

• You speak fluent Dutch or English.

• You can work independently and are accurate with administration.

• You are comfortable with a PC and onboard computer.

• You are willing to work an average of 12 hours per day.

• You live within commuting distance to Hooglede.

As an operator, together with a colleague, you are responsible for operating and setting up the production line. You use an overhead crane, set the correct parameters and knife distances, and make sure the rolls are properly packaged. Some administrative work on the computer is also part of your job. You work in two fixed shifts: from 5 a.m. to 1 p.m. or from 1 p.m. to 9 p.m.
Every day is varied: setting up machines, performing quality checks, and processing production documentation. You are alert to safety and contribute to a smooth production process.
Does this job appeal to you? Apply now!

• Relevant experience as an operator

• Technical insight and logical thinking

• Good computer skills

• Attention to quality and safety

• Stress-resistant and result-oriented

• Team player

• You speak fluent Dutch or English

jobs.occupation: Sales operations representative EN/DE | Brecht | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
Position: Sales Operations Representative / Order Administrator 

Location: Brecht 

As a Sales Operations Representative / Order Processor, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth order processing and customer satisfaction. You will follow up on orders, report and resolve incidents, and communicate effectively with both customers and internal departments. You will coordinate shipments with factories and be an integral part of the team based in Brecht, handling orders for the US market. 

Primary Duties & Responsibilities: 

 
• Review incoming customer orders for items, pricing, and export license requirements. 
 
• Process sales orders in the ERP system (SAP) using the ESKER tool. 
 
• Process purchase orders at manufacturing plants, if required. 
 
• Follow up on sales orders with manufacturing plants and warehouses to ensure timely delivery. 
 
• Communicate with customers regarding their orders; resolve delivery issues, respond to inquiries, and provide necessary delivery documentation. 
 
• Request export documentation from customers as needed. 
 
• Invoice customers after delivery and monitor customer balances prior to shipment. 
 
• Maintain and closely monitor order backlog. 
 
• Record orders and customer information in internal systems and files. 
 
• Serve as a backup for other Sales Operations Specialists when needed. 

 
• A college Diploma or equivalent required, AS or higher in business preferred. 
 
• A first experience in Customer service - Order Processing is required. 
 
• A very good and professional command of English is required. In addition, you also have a good command of German. 
 
• Ability to communicate effectively: strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 
• Flexible, easy-going and able to adapt to a fast-paced and sometimes changing environment. 
 
• Good time management skills with the ability to prioritize, follow-through, and complete tasks on time. 
 
• Focused and versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure. 
 
• Detail oriented with high level of accuracy. 
 
• Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills. 
 
• Self-motivated and good level of focus/concentration. 
 
• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. 
 
• Strong computer skills and experience with SAP. 
 
• You have your own transportation and a valid driving license (difficult to reach by public transport).

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.

• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.

• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.

• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.

• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.

• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.

• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.

• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.

• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).

• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.

• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.

• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

We are looking for a logistic operator for warehouse in Vilvoorde. The company is active in the medical field. You will join the kitting team and provide support to clinical supplies operations and administrative activities in all areas of clinical supplies lifecycle of low to moderate complexity studies.

Your tasks:

 

 
• You support logistics and administrative tasks related to clinical supplies and medical devices. 
 
• You ensure smooth processes for ordering, storage, labelling, shipping, and returns. 
 
• You track inventory levels and expiration dates, and prepare monthly reports. 
 
• You ensure all activities follow guidelines and internal procedures. 
 
• You maintain accurate data in electronic systems for the assigned studies. 
 
• You perform routine tasks and prepare the kits for the labs. 
 
• You handle ad-hoc supply purchases when needed. 

Your profile:

 

 
• You have a good command of English (spoken and written). 
 
• You have at least 2 years of relevant experience in a warehouse environment. 
 
• You are comfortable using computers and electronic equipment. 
 
• You are able to sit for 4–6 hours per day. 
 
• You can lift light objects (up to 7–9 kg). 
 
• You have a solid knowledge of clinical supply processes (e.g. manufacturing, shipping, labeling, auditing). 
 
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office. 
 
• You pay close attention to detail and quality-focused. 
 
• You are available until 3/10.

Are you a real night owl and do you enjoy an active, hands-on job? Then we may have the perfect job for you! We are looking for a motivated Warehouse Operator to join the permanent night shift. You will work for a stable and growing company where you can count on proper training, a great team atmosphere and an attractive salary package. Your responsibilities As a Warehouse Operator, you play an important role in the logistics process. You make sure that goods are processed correctly and that orders are ready for shipment. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods
 
• Picking orders using voice picking and/or scanning
 
• Preparing orders accurately and on time for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Moving goods using an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck
 
• Keeping the warehouse clean, organised and safe
 
• Following safety, hygiene and quality procedures (HACCP)
 
• Working in a chilled environment, including a freezer area 

Who are we looking for? You don't need years of experience for this position. Motivation and the right attitude are just as important! We are looking for someone who:
 

 
• Preferably has experience as a warehouse operator, although motivated candidates without experience are also welcome
 
• Works accurately and responsibly
 
• Is not afraid of physical work and enjoys being hands-on
 
• Can work independently as well as in a team
 
• Speaks and understands Dutch and/or English
 
• Has experience with an electric pallet truck or reach truck (a valid certificate is a plus)
 
• Is comfortable working in a cold/freezer environment
 
• Is willing to work the permanent night shift
